verdict.rationale: A state tax agency could plausibly document a sanctioned third-party rail such as power of attorney, authorized representatives, or preparer access, so this axis applies. The evidence pack contains nothing on designees, representatives, registered agents, or authorized providers acting for a business. The bare 'For Tax Software Developers' heading and the IRS-schema filing formats are adjacent developer and filing channels, not a documented delegated-access mechanism.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company
